title: Prove the realized production baseline before optimizing or materializing a local alternative

source.title: Qwen3-Omni TP4 SM120 tuned Triton versus production-selected FlashInfer reproduction
source.claim_scope: On one RTX 5090 and the frozen unquantized Qwen3-Omni TP4 MoE shape portfolio, targeted Triton reached only 0.66736x geomean of the production-selected FlashInfer CUTLASS control; this rejects that routing/config candidate and is not portable performance evidence.

implementation_recipe: Resolve and record the backend, implementation and fallback that the frozen production workload actually selects before choosing a control or downloading workload assets.
Compare a proposed alternative first against that realized production control, not only against the nearest generic implementation that the candidate improves.
Trace the exact production branch and count how often the proposed helper or fused path is reached under the frozen workload.
Measure target component self-time, CPU dispatch time, GPU active time and end-to-end time before implementing.
Compute an optimistic removable-work or Amdahl ceiling and compare it with the frozen materiality floor.
When several changes form a path, stage them independently and preserve zero-effect ablations instead of crediting the whole patch uniformly.
Use an interleaved stable control in the same session and treat effects inside measured run-order drift as no measurable gain.
Cancel model downloads, builds and whole-workload qualification when a cheap realized-backend comparison already makes the candidate unable to pass the frozen gate.
validation_recipe: Assert the realized backend and implementation identity for every arm before timing; configuration presence alone is not realization evidence.
Run an anchor-and-edge shape portfolio against the production-selected control before materializing large model assets.
Instrument eligible, ineligible and fallback branches and verify the measured workload actually executes the changed path.
Record launch count, component self-time, GPU active time, end-to-end latency and output identity in the same interleaved run.
Report each commit-stage delta and the deletion upper bound rather than only final-patch versus baseline.
Match capacity, concurrency, cache state and request shape before comparing alternative pools or backends.
Reject attribution when the control drifts by an amount comparable to the claimed change.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: A production-selected vendor or framework backend may dominate a locally tuned alternative even when that alternative beats its generic baseline.
An immaterial local helper should redirect search toward a larger adjacent path or orchestration boundary.
Making a previously unreachable fused path active can expose address ownership, padding and state-lifetime contracts.
After host launch chains are removed, GPU work, scheduler overhead or another stage may become dominant.
failure_modes: A tuned alternative is compared only with its untuned sibling while the production workload selects a faster third backend.
Large model weights are downloaded before a cheap realized-backend portfolio can disprove the routing opportunity.
A configuration file or environment flag is mistaken for proof that the target implementation executed.
A fast microbenchmark is measured on a branch the production workload never reaches.
A multi-commit patch credits every local change even when staged ablation shows one has zero pooled effect.
Inclusive profiler time or launch count is mistaken for removable critical-path time.
Control and treatment run in separate drifting sessions or use different capacity/concurrency settings.
A source-reported relative gap without absolute samples is converted into a fabricated speedup ratio.
A microsecond-scale change is credited for a larger end-to-end fluctuation than its optimistic bound permits.
scope_limits: The Qwen3-Omni result applies only to its frozen SM120, TP4, dtype, shape and backend identities; architecture, quantization or workload changes require a new control.
A zero-effect stage in one workload does not prove the helper is universally immaterial.
Architecture, backend and execution-mode changes require a new production-share and reachability trace.
Community staged results route hypotheses but cannot replace target-hardware reproduction.

algorithmic_decomposition.baseline_dependency: End-to-end value is relative to the implementation production actually selects, and a proposed local change contributes only on branches reached by the frozen workload.
algorithmic_decomposition.partition_axis: realized production backend versus proposed alternative, then reachable component critical-path time versus unaffected end-to-end latency
local_state: CPU launch and GPU active intervals
algorithmic_decomposition.combine_rule: First compare the alternative with the realized production backend; only surviving alternatives may combine reachable stage bounds with unchanged residual latency.
algorithmic_decomposition.finalization: Admit implementation, asset materialization or further qualification only when the alternative beats the realized control and its optimistic global interval clears materiality after drift and capacity controls.
algorithmic_decomposition.work_complexity: One backend-realization probe and anchor/edge comparison, followed only for survivors by branch trace and representative attribution.
algorithmic_decomposition.span_complexity: The gate precedes large downloads, expensive builds and whole-workload qualification and closes dominated or unreachable candidates early.
algorithmic_decomposition.communication_cost: Adds temporary realization assertions and staged measurements but no permanent production data movement.
invariants: the control is the backend selected by the frozen production path
backend identity is observed rather than inferred from configuration
branch counts correspond to the frozen production workload
component critical-path time does not exceed end-to-end time
each staged attribution uses the same control and capacity contract
claimed global gain does not exceed reachable removable work
effects inside control drift remain inconclusive
anti_patterns: compare only against the candidate's generic sibling
download model assets before resolving the production backend
infer realization from a config file
rank by local speedup or launch count alone
credit a final bundle without staged ablation
compare different sessions, capacities or execution modes
keep optimizing below the materiality floor

candidate_archetypes.name: production-selected backend comparison before materialization
candidate_archetypes.template: Assert the production-selected backend, compare the proposed alternative on anchor and edge shapes, and cancel large asset materialization when the alternative is already dominated.

candidate_archetypes.name: reachable production attribution before implementation
candidate_archetypes.template: Trace the changed branch, measure its production share, derive the optimistic global ceiling, and admit implementation only if it clears materiality.

candidate_archetypes.name: same-session component attribution
candidate_archetypes.template: Apply one coherent patch stage at a time against an interleaved stable control, retaining zero-effect results and assigning gain only where observed bounds permit.
